setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json. A test contact, a test company and two test deals created for the evals: one in an open stage (<deal>) and one in a closing stage (<closed deal>). The key's user is the only assignee used. No meeting gets attendees or a calendar provider. Replace the placeholders with real names from that account.

evals.prompt: Créale una tarea al negocio <deal> para enviar la propuesta revisada, asignada a mí, que venza el <date> a las 5 pm hora de Bogotá, con recordatorio una hora antes.
evals.expected_output: Finds the deal, previews a task with the due date converted from Bogotá time and the reminder an hour earlier, waits for the yes, applies and reports the task code, all in Spanish.
expectations: Uses scripts/activity.js (find, preview, apply), never a hand-made POST
The plan's dueAt carries the -05:00 offset (17:00 local = 22:00 UTC) and reminder '1 Hour'
Shows the preview and waits for an explicit yes before apply
After apply, the task exists with origin Deal, assignee = the key's user, dueReminderAt one hour before dueAt, and the deal's tasks list contains it

evals.prompt: Schedule a virtual meeting on the deal <deal> on <date> from 10:00 to 10:30 Bogotá time to review the contract.
evals.expected_output: Explains that meetings live on contacts, not deals (the script blocks it), and asks which contact to log it on; writes nothing on the deal.
expectations: Runs preview (or reads the deal) and reports the blocker in plain words
Does not create a meeting with origin Deal and does not look for another way to attach it to the deal
Offers to log it on the deal's contact, or asks for the contact when the deal has none

evals.prompt: What has happened lately with the contact <contact>? Show me their activity.
evals.expected_output: Runs history on the contact and summarizes the latest activities (type, date, who, text) newest first, without writing anything.
expectations: Finds the contact with find and runs history
Lists the most recent activities in plain words, newest first
Mentions unlinked activities if history reports any

evals.prompt: Book a meeting with <contact> next Tuesday at 3 pm and send them a Google Calendar invite.
evals.expected_output: Explains that calendar invitations are sent only by meetings created in the app with a connected calendar, offers a meeting without an invitation, and only creates it after a yes.
expectations: Does not set provider or inviteParticipants and does not try to send an e-mail
Asks for the time zone and the meeting mode if they were not given
If the user accepts, the meeting is on the contact with no attendees it was not told about

evals.prompt: I added a note to the deal <closed deal> through our integration, it answered with an error, but the note is there. What happened?
evals.expected_output: Runs history on the deal, explains that the server saves the note before linking it and that a closing stage can reject the link, and reports whether the note is linked or unlinked; changes nothing without a yes.
expectations: Runs history on the deal and reads the unlinked list
Explains the save-then-link behavior in plain words
Does not delete or relink anything without an explicit yes
